evals.name: redesign-member-dashboard
evals.prompt: che este dashboard de socios quedo horrible, parece hecho por un programador jaja. Es el MemberDashboard.tsx que te paso. Podes dejarlo mas profesional? usamos tailwind en el proyecto. Ah y ojo que la lista puede tener 200 socios
evals.expected_output: Rewritten component with a real spacing/type scale, one primary action, restrained color (no purple/pink gradient, no emoji in the heading), table or list layout suited to 200 rows, and hover/focus/loading/empty states.
assertions: The purple-to-pink gradient is gone from the output
No emoji is used in the heading or as an interface icon
Spacing uses scale classes rather than arbitrary values (no p-[13px]-style one-offs)
Exactly one visually primary action button in the header region
Interactive elements define a visible focus-visible style
The empty state (no members or no search results) is handled explicitly
Layout suits ~200 rows: a table or dense list rather than one large card per member
Body text is not pure #000 on pure #fff

evals.name: build-checkin-screen
evals.prompt: necesito armar la pantalla de check-in que va en una tablet en la entrada del gimnasio. El socio pone su codigo de 6 digitos y le tiene que aparecer si entro bien o si tiene la cuota vencida. React + tailwind. Que se vea bien porque lo van a ver los socios todo el dia
evals.expected_output: New component with clear hierarchy for the single primary task, large touch targets, high contrast for at-a-distance reading, and explicit success/error/loading/idle states.
assertions: One dominant primary element for entering the 6-digit code
Success and expired-membership states are distinguished by more than color alone
A submitting/loading state prevents double submission
Font sizes come from a small consistent type scale
An idle/ready state is defined for the always-on screen
